notes: State expectations come from games/abyss-signal/tests/model.py, whose advance() is the upstream model.py (jr100dev games/abyss_signal 1.6.1) and whose panel, photo and questions follow upstream src/main.asm, not from the emulator. synthetic-survey plays the upstream replay.py route (sonar at each leg, the shortest route to each site, record from the panel, then home): 117 actions. Key gaps leave 650000 cycles per action and 1650000 for a sonar sweep (a move or a drift also draws its half-cell frame). synthetic-title, synthetic-survey and synthetic-lost require a PCM peak of 21000. The local-rom profiles load the CJR with MLOAD from the owned ROM, type A=USR($1000) at cycle 110000000 and replay the synthetic keys 113700000 cycles later; they need owned ROM/FONT.
